title: Aspect Mastery
intro: At C1 level, aspect becomes a tool for expressing subtle shades of meaning. POLITENESS: Question forms are softer (Вы не подскажете? vs. Подскажите!); imperfective imperatives are softer (Садитесь! vs. Сядьте!). DEFINITENESS: Perfective implies certainty (Я это сделаю = I will definitely do it). EXPERIENCE VS COMPLETION: Ты читал? (Have you read/experienced?) vs. Ты прочитал? (Did you finish?). NEGATION NUANCES: Imperfective negation is neutral (не читал = didn't read), perfective negation can imply failure (не прочитал = didn't manage to finish). REPEATED PAST WITH RESULTS: Each time aspect choice affects meaning. Master these nuances for truly native-like Russian.
rules: Politeness: Question form softer than imperative; impf imperative softer (Садитесь!) than pf (Сядьте!)
Definiteness: Perfective = certainty - Я сделаю (I will do) vs Я буду делать (ongoing)
Experience vs completion: Ты читал? (experience) vs Ты прочитал? (finished)
Negation nuance: не делал (neutral) vs не сделал (failed to complete)
examples: Вы не подскажете, как пройти? (Could you tell me how to get there?, polite impf)
Я обязательно это сделаю. (I will definitely do this., definite pf)
Ты смотрел этот фильм? (Have you seen this movie?, experience)
Я не успел прочитать книгу. (I didn't manage to finish the book., failed completion)

items.prompt: Polite request: Вы не _____, где метро? (tell)
items.promptEnglish: Could you tell me where the metro is?
items.explanation: Polite: Вы не подскажете? (question, not imperative)

items.prompt: Definite promise: Я обязательно это _____. (will do)

items.promptEnglish: Have you read War and Peace?
items.explanation: Experience: Ты читал? (have you ever read)

items.promptEnglish: Have you finished the report yet?

items.prompt: Neutral negation: Я вчера не _____ телевизор. (watched)
Failed attempt: Я не _____ дозвониться. (managed to call)
items.promptEnglish: I couldn't get through (on the phone).

items.prompt: Repeated past (each time completed): Раньше каждый раз он _____ задачу. (solved)
items.promptEnglish: He used to solve the problem each time.
items.hint: Repeated = imperfective (even if completed each time)

items.prompt: Single completed: Вчера он наконец _____ задачу. (solved)
items.promptEnglish: Yesterday he finally solved the problem.

items.prompt: Indirect command (polite): Она попросила, чтобы я _____. (called)
Я вчера не _____ отчёт. (не успел закончить)
items.promptEnglish: I didn't finish the report yesterday. (failed attempt)
items.hint: Совершенный вид с отрицанием = не удалось завершить
items.explanation: Не написал = не удалось завершить (неудача). Не писал = просто не писал (нейтрально).

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Polite requests use question form (Вы не...?) rather than imperative
hints: Polite requests use 'Вы не...?' with the future indicative form, not the imperative. Which ending signals future indicative vs. imperative?
explanations: 'Подскажете' (future indicative) forms the polite question 'Вы не подскажете?' 'Подскажите' is the imperative (a direct command). The -ете ending (indicative) is polite; the -ите ending (imperative) is more direct.
